name: Flirtey (SkyDrop)
long_description:
- Firsts & Smithsonian: First approved US drone delivery; Drone in Smithsonian
- Built hard hardware: Partnered with NASA; 11 granted US drone patents
- Investment: Raised $40M; Grew to $120M valuation
- Product-market fit: Government and medical partnerships
- Commercial deals: 7-Eleven, FedEx, and Domino’s
one_liner: Flirtey is the world’s first commercial drone delivery service
